<!--
PR title MUST be a Conventional Commit — it becomes the squash commit on main
and drives the version bump. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

  feat(scope): add thing        -> minor bump
  fix(scope): stop thing        -> patch bump
  feat(scope)!: change thing    -> major bump (or a BREAKING CHANGE: footer)
  chore/docs/ci/refactor/...    -> no release
-->
